_comment: Custom items (Managers.CustomItems). The client only draws the items it knows, so a custom
item is made over one of them: it keeps the base's NAME, ICON, TYPE and LEVEL, and gets
the effects and the worn look written here. Read when the server starts.
base     the item it is made over (its id, as in the F10 window or .item)
skinOf   worn with the look of this other item (or  skin: a skin id directly)
effects  the characteristics every new one is born with, fixed, no roll. Leave it out
to keep the base's own rolls. Names: vitalite, sagesse, force, intelligence,
chance, agilite, puissance, pa, pm, po, dommages, soins, initiative,
prospection, invocations, critique, tacle, fuite, pods -- or an effect id.
A negative value is a malus.
Every way an item is made gives the custom one: .item, the F10 window, drops, crafts,
shops. Items made before keep their old effects. Remove a row to undo it.
